verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a public REST API with API-key/Bearer-token authentication (endpoints overview), plus an official MCP server that lets AI clients like Claude/Cursor/Codex drive the whole platform programmatically, satisfying the 'documented public API for AI-native use' story. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s on standard OpenAPI paths) and independent third-party confirmation of API robustness.
